concerns.text: FR-015 (record solvent, temperature, measurement‑method metadata) has no corresponding task, script, or contract in the implementation plan. The plan’s phases and quickstart steps never mention extracting or storing this metadata.
FR-016 (use a curated reference set of fluorophore motifs) is absent from the plan. No data file, script, or contract for `data/reference/fluorophore_motifs.csv` is referenced.
SC-001 (measure and report GNN R² vs. baseline) is not mapped to any phase. All modeling phases are deferred, and the plan does not include a placeholder or deferred task for this success criterion.
SC-005 (validate interpretability by overlap with reference motifs) is missing from the plan. No step or script is linked to this metric, despite FR‑006/FR‑007 being present.
SC-006 (correlation between Integrated Gradients and SHAP on ≥30 test molecules) is not addressed in any phase or deferred task.
SC-007 (final report artifact) is not represented in the plan. The only reporting phase is marked ‘Deferred’ with no concrete deliverable or contract.
SC-008 (pipeline must respect 6‑hour wall‑clock and 7 GB RAM limits) is not explicitly linked to any success‑check entry; only resource‑monitoring logs are mentioned, but no SC mapping is provided.
Phase 8 Reporting is listed as ‘Deferred’ but the spec contains no FR or SC that requires a reporting step. This phase appears to be over‑reaching beyond the current specification.
